description: Office of the Governor, Uva Province - Appointments has been Mrs.R. M. S. D. Rathnayake and 18 others for Uva Province Institutions
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments and acting assignments) for named individuals in the Uva Provincial Council. It provides basic titles and positions (e.g., "Deputy Chief Secretary," "Secretary to the Ministry of...") but does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses exclusively on who is being appointed to which positions without elaborating on what those positions entail, making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
